# Handy Services

> Handy Services is a fully insured, 4.9-star-rated handyman and home-improvement business serving Nottingham and Derby in the UK. One text and we sort it: painting, plastering, tiling, carpentry, kitchen and bathroom fitting, fencing, decking, gutter cleaning, pressure washing, and garden work — booked fast, done right, backed by a guarantee.

## About

Handy Services is a local, professional handyman and trades company covering Nottingham (Nottinghamshire) and Derby (Derbyshire). We are fully insured with £2M public-liability cover and rated 4.9 out of 5 on Google from 127 verified customer reviews. Every job is delivered by vetted tradespeople, backed by a 12-month workmanship guarantee, with photo reports and clear itemised quotes.

## Services

Handy Services delivers the following trades across Nottingham and Derby:

- [Handyman](https://www.handyservices.app): General repairs, odd jobs, flat-pack assembly, TV mounting, small fixes.
- [Painting & Decorating](https://www.handyservices.app): Interior and exterior painting, feature walls, full-room decorating.
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://www.handyservices.app): Gutter clearing, unblocking, and minor gutter repairs.
- [Fencing](https://www.handyservices.app): Fence panel replacement, new fence installation, posts and gates.
- [Plastering](https://www.handyservices.app): Skimming, patch plastering, full re-plastering, rendering.
- [Kitchen Fitting](https://www.handyservices.app): Kitchen installation, unit fitting, worktops, appliance install.
- [Tiling](https://www.handyservices.app): Wall and floor tiling for kitchens, bathrooms, and splashbacks.
- [Carpentry](https://www.handyservices.app): Bespoke joinery, shelving, doors, skirting, and repairs.
- [Garden & Landscaping](https://www.handyservices.app): Garden clearance, turfing, planting, and landscaping.
- [Pressure Washing](https://www.handyservices.app): Driveways, patios, decking, and exterior surface cleaning.
- [Decking](https://www.handyservices.app): New decking builds, repairs, and treatment.
- [Bathroom Fitting](https://www.handyservices.app): Full and partial bathroom installation and refurbishment.
